positioning: Global category leader in Physical AI for large industrial sites

scale.note: Powers autonomous operations across large, complex industrial sites

referenceable_customer_context.Shell: Energy and refining — hazardous process infrastructure, large remote sites, safety-critical inspections at scale
referenceable_customer_context.Anglo American: Mining — large-scale extraction operations, industrial safety and inspection demands directly comparable to LatAm mining accounts
referenceable_customer_context.CSX: Heavy rail and industrial logistics — 24/7 operations, vast linear and site infrastructure requiring continuous inspection

flytbase_angle.core: Autonomous drone inspection replacing contracted inspection crews
value_pillars: Replace contracted crews on dangerous inspection tasks with autonomous drone missions
Continuous (24/7) inspection coverage instead of periodic manual crews
Remove personnel from high-risk environments (pit walls, tailings, haul roads, elevated infrastructure)
Consistent, repeatable inspection data with full mission records for compliance
Lower per-inspection cost at scale across multiple sites
mine_inspection_use_cases: Pit wall and highwall stability inspection
Tailings dam and storage facility monitoring
Haul road and access road condition surveys
Structural inspection of processing plants, crushers and elevated infrastructure
Pre- and post-event inspection after incidents or weather events

icp_context.target_vertical: Large-scale lithium, copper, and iron ore mining operations in Latin America
icp_context.reference_account: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile (SQM)
icp_context.goal: Book discovery calls with Head of Operations, VP of HSE, or Site Directors at similar companies
qualifying_signals: Large-scale extraction operations (single or multiple large sites)
Hazardous environments requiring contracted inspection crews
Lithium, copper, or iron ore focus
Latin America geography (Chile, Argentina, Peru, Brazil, Mexico)
Expansion, new assets, or technology investment signals

email_tone_guidelines: Sound like a human BDR who studied the account, not a marketing tool
Open with a specific, verifiable observation about the account's operations or recent news
Connect the observation to an operational pain in the recipient's lane (operations safety, HSE risk, inspection workload)
Introduce FlytBase's angle briefly: autonomous drone inspection replacing contracted crews at hazardous 24/7 sites
Reference a FlytBase customer (Shell / Anglo American / CSX) only where it genuinely strengthens the framing (e.g., Anglo American for mining peers)
End with a low-friction CTA (a short call, not a commitment)
No {placeholder} tokens, no generic industry platitudes, no fabricated facts
